## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Early Expressions?
No: 1447, Ram Nagar (North Ext), Madipakkam, Chennai 600 091.

### What facilities does Early Expressions have?
Play Group (1.5–2.5 yrs), Nursery, Kindergarten (3.5–5.5 yrs, EYFS), Day care, After-school programme, Phonics, Handwriting, Hindi tuition, Spell Bee (7–11 yrs), Western dance & Zumba, Classical dance, Yoga, Tuition, 1st to 10th Std, Field trips, A/C nap room, Bus service.

### What ages do you take?
Play group is for 1.5 to 2.5 years and kindergarten for 3.5 to 5.5 years. Day care and after-school classes are also available.

### What after-school classes are there?
Phonics, handwriting, Hindi tuition, western and classical dance, Zumba, yoga, Spell Bee, and tuition for all subjects from 1st to 10th Std.

### How do I visit Early Expressions?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 99401 65660. We're open Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 7 PM.
